text:
Natalia sold 48 / 2 = 24 clips in May.
Natalia sold 48 + 24 = 72 clips altogether in April and May.
The answer is 72.

Weng earns 12 / 60 = $0.2 per minute.
Working 50 minutes, she earned 0.2 * 50 = $10.
The answer is 10.

At the beginning, Betty has half of the $100 she needs, so she has 100 / 2 = 50.
Her parents gave her $15.
Her grandparents gave her twice as much as her parents, so they gave 15 * 2 = 30.
The total money Betty now has is 50 + 15 + 30 = 95.
The amount she still needs is 100 - 95 = 5.
The answer is 5.

Julie read 12 * 2 = 24 pages today.
So she was able to read a total of 12 + 24 = 36 pages since yesterday.
There are 120 - 36 = 84 pages left to be read.
Since she wants to read half of the remaining pages tomorrow, then she should read 84 / 2 = 42 pages.
The answer is 42.

James writes a 3-page letter to each friend twice a week, so he writes 3 * 2 = 6 pages per friend per week.
He has 2 friends, so he writes 6 * 2 = 12 pages per week.
There are 52 weeks in a year, so he writes 12 * 52 = 624 pages a year.
The answer is 624.

There are 80/100 * 10 = 8 more purple flowers than yellow flowers.
So in Mark's garden, there are 10 + 8 = 18 purple flowers.
Purple and yellow flowers sum up to 10 + 18 = 28 flowers.
That means in Mark's garden there are 25/100 * 28 = 7 green flowers.
So in total Mark has 28 + 7 = 35 plants in his garden.
The answer is 35.

He eats 32 slices from the large pizzas because 2 * 16 = 32.
He eats 16 slices from the small pizzas because 2 * 8 = 16.
He eats 48 pieces because 32 + 16 = 48.
The answer is 48.

To the initial 2 pounds of jelly beans, he added enough brownies to cause the weight to triple, bringing the weight to 2 * 3 = 6 pounds.
Next, he added another 2 pounds of jelly beans, bringing the weight to 6 + 2 = 8 pounds.
And finally, he added enough gummy worms to double the weight once again, to a final weight of 8 * 2 = 16 pounds.
The answer is 16.

Let S be the amount Alexis paid for the shoes.
She spent S + 30 + 46 + 38 + 11 + 18 = S + 143.
She has $16 left from her $200 budget, so she spent 200 - 16 = 184.
Thus, S = 184 - 143 = 41.
The answer is 41.

Tina works 8 hours a day at $18 per hour, so her base pay is 8 * 18 = $144.00 per day.
She works 10 hours each day, so she has 10 - 8 = 2 hours of overtime.
Overtime is time and a half, so she earns 18 * 0.5 = $9.00 per overtime hour.
Her overtime rate is 18 + 9 = $27.00 per hour.
She works 2 hours of overtime per day, so her daily overtime pay is 27 * 2 = $54.00.
She works 5 days, so her total overtime pay is 54 * 5 = $270.00.
Her total base pay for 5 days is 144 * 5 = $720.00.
Her total earnings are 720 + 270 = $990.00.
The answer is 990.

Let S be the number of people on the ship in the first hundred years.
The ship in the second hundred years had twice as many as the first, so it had 2S people.
The ship in the third hundred years had twice as many as the second, so it had 2 * 2S = 4S people.
The total number of people eaten is S + 2S + 4S = 7S = 847.
Thus, S = 847 / 7 = 121.
The answer is 121.

Tobias saved up $110 total because 95 + 15 = 110.
He saved $15 from his allowance because 3 * 5 = 15.
He earned $60 mowing lawns because 4 * 15 = 60.
He earned $35 shoveling driveways because 110 - 60 - 15 = 35.
He shoveled 5 driveways because 35 / 7 = 5.
The answer is 5.

Half of the number of Randy's mango trees is 60 / 2 = 30 trees.
So Randy has 30 - 5 = 25 coconut trees.
Therefore, Randy has 60 + 25 = 85 trees on his farm.
The answer is 85.

A pound of cream cheese costs $10 / 2 = $5.
A pack of cold cuts costs $10 * 2 = $20.
Jasper spent $10 + $5 + $20 = $35 on the ingredients.
The answer is 35.

There are 3 sets of 20 minutes in one hour.
So, Joy can read 8 * 3 = 24 pages in one hour.
It will take her 120 / 24 = 5 hours to read 120 pages.
The answer is 5.

He sells each DVD for 6 * 2.5 = 15 dollars.
So he makes a profit of 15 - 6 = 9 dollars per DVD.
Each day he sells 500 DVDs, so his daily profit is 9 * 500 = 4500 dollars.
He sells movies for 5 days a week, so his weekly profit is 4500 * 5 = 22,500 dollars.
Over 20 weeks, his total profit is 22,500 * 20 = 450,000 dollars.
After subtracting the cost of creating the movie, his total profit is 450,000 - 2000 = 448,000 dollars.
The answer is 448000.

According to the ratio, for every 5 parts that Johnson gets, Mike gets 2 parts.
Since Johnson got $2500, each part is $2500 / 5 = $500.
Mike will get 2 * $500 = $1000.
After buying the shirt that costs $200, he will have $1000 - $200 = $800 left.
The answer is 800.

There were 26 pink hard hats and Carl took away 4, so 26 - 4 = 22 pink hard hats remained.
John took away 6 pink hard hats, so 22 - 6 = 16 pink hard hats remained.
John took twice as many green hard hats as the pink hard hats he removed, so he took 2 * 6 = 12 green hard hats.
There were 15 green hard hats initially, so 15 - 12 = 3 green hard hats remained.
There were 24 yellow hard hats, and none were taken away.
The total number of hard hats remaining is 16 pink + 3 green + 24 yellow = 43.
The answer is 43.

Roque takes 2 hours to walk to work, so for three trips to and from work, he takes 2 * 3 = 6 hours to walk to work.
Roque takes 6 hours a week to walk to and from work.
Roque takes 1 hour to bike to work, so for two trips to and from work, he takes 1 * 2 = 2 hours to bike to work.
Roque takes 2 * 2 = 4 hours a week to bike to and from work.
In total, Roque takes 12 + 4 = 16 hours a week to go to and from work.
The answer is 16.

Tim bikes 20 * 2 = 40 miles each day for work.
So he bikes 40 * 5 = 200 miles for work.
That means he bikes a total of 200 + 200 = 400 miles for work and his weekend ride.
At a speed of 25 mph, he spends 400 / 25 = 16 hours biking a week.
The answer is 16.

The number of truck stamps is 11 + 9 = 20.
The number of rose stamps is 20 − 13 = 7.
Bella bought 11 + 20 + 7 = 38 stamps in all.
The answer is 38.

First find the total number of snakes eaten: 5 snakes/jaguar * 6 jaguars = 30 snakes.
Then find the total number of birds eaten per day: 30 snakes * 3 birds/snake = 90 birds.
Then multiply the number of birds by the number of beetles per bird to find the total number of beetles eaten per day: 90 birds * 12 beetles/bird = 1080 beetles.
The answer is 1080.

Jamie’s last name is Grey, which has 4 letters.
Bobbie’s last name is twice the length of Jamie’s plus 2, so Bobbie’s last name has 4 * 2 + 2 = 10 letters.
Samantha’s last name has 3 fewer letters than Bobbie’s, so it has 10 - 3 = 7 letters.
The answer is 7.

She bought 5 shorts at $7 each so 5 * 7 = 35
She bought 2 pairs of shoes at $10 each so 2 * 10 = 20
The shorts and shoes cost her 35 + 20 = 55
She spent a total of $75, so the remaining amount for the tops is 75 - 55 = 20
She bought 4 tops for a total of $20 so 20 / 4 = 5
The answer is 5.

Mary has paid $15 on Tuesday and $23 on Thursday, so she has paid back $15 + $23 = $38.
She was allowed a credit of $100, so she still needs to pay $100 - $38 = $62.
The answer is 62.

Out of the first 100 balls, Ralph did not hit 3/5 of them, so 3/5 * 100 = 60 tennis balls he didn't hit.
Out of the next 75 balls, Ralph did not hit 2/3 of them, so 2/3 * 75 = 50 tennis balls he didn't hit.
Combined, Ralph did not hit 60 + 50 = 110 tennis balls.
The answer is 110.

First find how many liters of the seawater are salt: 2 * 20% = 0.4 liters
Then multiply that amount by 1000 ml/liter to find the number of ml of salt Jack gets: 0.4 * 1000 = 400 ml
The answer is 400.

The number of non-valuable files Brennan downloaded in the first round is 70/100 * 800 = 560 files.
The number of valuable files Brennan downloaded in the first round is 800 - 560 = 240.
When he downloaded 400 new files, there were 3/5 * 400 = 240 non-useful files, which he deleted again.
The total number of valuable files he downloaded in the second round is 400 - 240 = 160.
To write his research, Brennan had 160 + 240 = 400 useful files to reference.
The answer is 400.

The first four houses have 4 * 3 = 12 gnomes in total.
The fifth house has 20 - 12 = 8 gnomes.
The answer is 8.

Let her previous monthly income be p.
The cost of her rent and utilities was 40% of p, which is (40/100) * p = 2p/5.
Her income after the increase is p + 600.
The cost of her rent and utilities now is 25% of (p + 600), which is (25/100) * (p + 600) = (p + 600)/4.
Equating both expressions for rent and utilities: 2p/5 = (p + 600)/4.
Multiplying both sides of the equation by 20 gives 8p = 5p + 3000.
Subtracting 5p from both sides gives 3p = 3000.
Dividing both sides by 3 gives p = 1000.
The answer is 1000.

There are 4 people, and each pizza is cut into 4 pieces, so there are 4 * 4 = 16 pizza pieces in total.
Bill and Dale eat 50% of their pizzas, so they eat 2 * 4 * 50% = 4 pieces.
Ann and Cate eat 75% of their pizzas, so they eat 2 * 4 * 75% = 6 pieces.
Together, they eat 4 + 6 = 10 pieces.
The number of uneaten pieces is 16 - 10 = 6.
The answer is 6.

Noah earned $60 per large painting times 8 large paintings = $480 for the large paintings.
He earned $30 per small painting times 4 small paintings = $120 for the small paintings.
His total sales last month were $480 + $120 = $600.
So, his sales this month are $600 times 2 = $1200.
The answer is 1200.

After the 1st turn, the car traveled 5 meters.
After the 2nd turn, it traveled 8 meters.
After the 4th turn, it traveled 0 meters.
So the total distance traveled after the first three turns and at the fourth turn is 5 + 8 + 0 = 13 meters.
The car drove a total of 23 meters around the ring.
Therefore, it traveled 23 - 13 = 10 meters after the 3rd turn.
The answer is 10.

Kimber needs 1/2 * 16 = 8 teaspoons of salt.
The total number of cups of flour and teaspoons of salt is 8 + 16 = 24.
She also needs 10 cups of water, so the combined total is 24 + 10 = 34.
The answer is 34.

Tony got twice as much as Ken, so he got 2 * 1750 = 3500.
The total amount shared was 1750 + 3500 = 5250.
The answer is 5250.

40% of the students got a grade below B, so 100% - 40% = 60% got a grade of B and above.
Mr. Sanchez has 60 students, so 60 * 60 / 100 = 36 students got a grade of B and above.
The answer is 36.

Lisa earned 60 * 1/2 = 30 dollars.
Tommy earned 30 * 1/2 = 15 dollars.
Lisa earned 30 - 15 = 15 dollars more than Tommy.
The answer is 15.

The cost of 5 pieces of hamburger is $3 * 5 = $15.
The cost of 4 sets of French fries is $1.20 * 4 = $4.80.
The cost of 5 cups of soda is $0.5 * 5 = $2.50.
So their total bill is $15 + $4.80 + $2.50 + $2.7 = $25.
Hence, each of the five friends will contribute $25 / 5 = $5.
The answer is 5.

She is making 72 ounces of tea because 12 x 6 = 72.
She needs 9 ounces of tea because 72 / 8 = 9.
The answer is 9.

Anna gets 14 pieces of candy per house, so she gets 14 * 60 = 840 pieces of candy.
Billy gets 11 pieces of candy per house, so he gets 11 * 75 = 825 pieces of candy.
The difference in the number of pieces they get is 840 - 825 = 15 pieces.
The answer is 15.

Mr. Benson bought 12 tickets and received a 5% discount for each ticket beyond 10, so he got a discount on 12 - 10 = 2 tickets.
Each discount is 40 * 5 / 100 = 2 dollars.
So each discounted ticket costs 40 - 2 = 38 dollars.
The two discounted tickets cost 38 * 2 = 76 dollars.
The remaining 10 tickets cost 40 * 10 = 400 dollars.
Mr. Benson paid a total of 400 + 76 = 476 dollars.
The answer is 476.

The cost Rachel should budget for her pair of shoes is $50 * 2 = $100.
The cost Rachel should budget for her dress is $200 * 2 = $400.
The total Rachel should budget is $100 + $400 = $500.
The answer is 500.

The first 6 piles had 6 * 9 * 14 = 756 bananas.
There were 10 - 6 = 4 remaining piles.
The 4 remaining piles had 4 * 12 * 9 = 432 bananas.
All together, there were 756 + 432 = 1188 bananas.
Each monkey would get 1188 / 12 = 99 bananas.
The answer is 99.

The second earthquake caused 2 * 4 = 8 buildings to collapse.
The third earthquake caused 2 * 8 = 16 buildings to collapse.
The fourth earthquake caused 16 * 2 = 32 buildings to collapse.
Including the first earthquake, the earthquakes caused 4 + 8 + 16 + 32 = 60 buildings to collapse.
The answer is 60.

Accommodation is 15% * $1000 = $150
Food is 30% * $1000 = $300
Entertainment is 25% * $1000 = $250
Coursework materials are thus $1000 - ($150 + $300 + $250) = $300
The answer is 300.

The four bags of Reese's cost $9 * 4 = $36.
The three bags of Snickers cost $5 * 3 = $15.
The five bags of Skittles cost $7 * 5 = $35.
Therefore, the unicorn piñata and the treats cost $13 + $36 + $15 + $35 = $99.
The answer is 99.

Carolyn practices the piano for 20 minutes a day and the violin for three times as long, so her violin practice time is 20 * 3 = 60 minutes per day.
Her total practice time each day is 60 + 20 = 80 minutes per day.
She practices 6 days a week, so her weekly practice time is 80 * 6 = 480 minutes per week.
The month has 4 weeks, so her monthly practice time is 480 * 4 = 1920 minutes.
The answer is 1920.

The first 60 megabytes take 60 / 5 = 12 seconds.
There are 90 - 60 = 30 remaining megabytes.
The remaining 30 megabytes take 30 / 10 = 3 seconds.
And 12 + 3 = 15 seconds.
The answer is 15.

Carlos memorized 24 / 6 = 4 digits of pi.
Sam memorized 4 + 6 = 10 digits of pi.
The answer is 10.

Laurie collected 36 shells.
Ben collected a third of what Laurie did, so Ben collected 36 / 3 = 12 shells.
Alan collected four times as many shells as Ben, so Alan collected 12 * 4 = 48 shells.
The answer is 48.

Gerald spends $100 a month for 4 months, so he needs to save up 4 * 100 = 400 dollars.
He is not playing baseball for 12 - 4 = 8 months.
He needs to earn $400 over 8 months, so he must earn 400 / 8 = 50 dollars per month.
He charges $10 per chore, so he needs to do 50 / 10 = 5 chores per month.
The answer is 5.

The original bolt of fabric is 16 feet by 12 feet, so it has an area of 16 * 12 = 192 square feet.
Ann cut a 4 foot by 6 foot rectangle for the living room curtains, which uses 4 * 6 = 24 square feet.
She also cut a 2 foot by 4 foot rectangle for the bedroom curtains, which uses 2 * 4 = 8 square feet.
The total fabric used is 24 + 8 = 32 square feet.
The remaining fabric is 192 - 24 - 8 = 160 square feet.
The answer is 160.

Arnel shared 5 x 8 = 40 pencils with his friends.
So, he had 10 + 40 = 50 pencils in all.
Therefore, each box had 50 / 10 = 5 pencils inside.
The answer is 5.

The cost of the ice cream is 10 × $4 = $40.
The cost of the frozen yoghurt is 4 × $1 = $4.
Caleb spent $40 − $4 = $36 more on ice cream than on frozen yoghurt.
The answer is 36.

Leah spent 28 / 7 = $4 on a milkshake.
She had 28 - 4 = $24 left.
She put half in her savings account and half in her wallet, so she had 24 / 2 = $12 in her wallet.
Her dog shredded all the money in her wallet but $1, so Leah lost 12 - 1 = $11.
The answer is 11.

There are 25 + 40 + 35 = 100 flowers total.
There are 40 + 35 = 75 flowers that are not roses.
Therefore, (75 / 100) * 100 = 75% of the flowers are not roses.
The answer is 75.

It took Leo 25 * 2 = 50 minutes to finish the second part of the assignment.
Leo finished the first and second parts in 25 + 50 = 75 minutes.
He finished the entire assignment in 60 * 2 = 120 minutes.
Therefore, it took Leo 120 - 75 = 45 minutes to finish the third part of the assignment.
The answer is 45.

Liza used 10 / 2 = 5 kilograms of butter for the chocolate chip cookies.
She used 10 / 5 = 2 kilograms of butter for the peanut butter cookies.
She used 5 + 2 = 7 kilograms of butter for the chocolate and peanut butter cookies.
So, only 10 - 7 = 3 kilograms of butter was left.
Then, Liza used 3 / 3 = 1 kilograms of butter for the sugar cookies.
Therefore, only 3 - 1 = 2 kilograms of butter were left.
The answer is 2.

There are 60 students * 2/3 = 40 students who have a $6 daily allowance.
There are 60 students - 40 students = 20 students who have a $4 daily allowance.
The sum of the allowances of the 40 students who received $6 daily is 40 * $6 = $240.
The sum of the allowances of the 20 students who received $4 daily is 20 * $4 = $80.
The total daily amount of money of those 60 students is $240 + $80 = $320.
The answer is 320.

15 coins collected in hour one
35 coins collected in hour two
35 coins collected in hour three
50 coins collected in hour four
Before giving her coworker some coins there were 15 + 35 + 35 + 50 = 135 coins
The number of coins after giving 15 to her coworker is 135 - 15 = 120
The answer is 120.

Jerry will spend 8 games x 2 hours per game = 16 hours watching one daughter play her games.
He will spend 16 x 2 = 32 hours watching both daughters play their games.
He will spend 8 games x 4 hours of practice = 32 hours watching one daughter practice.
He will spend 32 x 2 = 64 hours watching both daughters practice.
He will spend a total of 32 hours watching games + 64 hours watching practice = 96 hours.
The answer is 96.

The bear gained 1 / 5 * 1000 = 200 pounds from berries.
It gained 2 * 200 = 400 pounds from acorns.
It still needed 1000 - 200 - 400 = 400 pounds.
Thus, it gained 400 / 2 = 200 pounds from salmon.
Therefore, the bear gained 400 - 200 = 200 pounds from small animals.
The answer is 200.

10 cans are holding 8 liters each for a total of 10 * 8 = 80 liters.
There are 290 - 80 = 210 liters left.
There are 24 - 10 = 14 cans left.
Each of the remaining cans is holding 210 / 14 = 15 liters each.
The answer is 15.

On Monday, Shawna was short of 30 - 12 = 18 situps.
On Tuesday, Shawna was short of 30 - 19 = 11 situps.
On Wednesday, Shawna would have to do 30 + 18 + 11 = 59 situps.
The answer is 59.

James earns 20 * 0.2 = 4 less while working his second job.
So he earns 20 - 4 = 16 an hour at his second job.
At his main job, he earns 20 * 30 = 600.
He works 30 / 2 = 15 hours at his second job.
So he earns 15 * 16 = 240 at his second job.
So he earns 600 + 240 = 840 a week.
The answer is 840.

Lee earned $33 for each lawn, and he mowed 16 lawns, so he earned 33 * 16 = 528 dollars from mowing lawns.
Three customers gave him a $10 tip each, so he earned 3 * 10 = 30 dollars in tips.
Adding the money from mowing and the tips, he earned 528 + 30 = 558 dollars.
The answer is 558.

Tara has to make a 20% down payment on the $1000 laptop, so her down payment is 1000 * 20 / 100 = 200.
Tara wants to pay $20 more for the down payment, so her total down payment is 200 + 20 = 220.
Her remaining balance after the down payment is 1000 - 220 = 780.
The monthly installment is 780 / 12 = 65.
After 4 months, she pays 65 * 4 = 260.
Her balance after 4 months is 780 - 260 = 520.
The answer is 520.

Jesse runs 2 miles in the first three days because 3 * (2/3) = 2.
Jesse has 18 miles left to run because 30 - 10 - 2 = 18.
Jesse has to run an average of 6 miles a day because 18 / 3 = 6.
Mia runs 12 miles over the first four days because 4 * 3 = 12.
She has 18 miles left to run because 30 - 12 = 18.
She has to run 6 miles a day because 18 / 3 = 6.
The total they both have to run is 12 miles a day.
The average they have to run per day on average is 6 miles because 12 / 2 = 6.
The answer is 6.

The total ratio of the coins they both have is 10 + 45 = 55.
The fraction of the ratio representing the number of coins that Amalie has is 45/55.
Since the total number of coins they both have is 440, Amalie has 45/55 * 440 = 360 coins.
When Amalie spends 3/4 of what she has, she parts with 3/4 * 360 = 270 coins.
She still has 360 - 270 = 90 coins.
The answer is 90.

First find the total number of starfish arms: 7 starfish * 5 arms/starfish = 35 arms
Then add the number of seastar arms to find the total number of arms: 35 arms + 14 arms = 49 arms
The answer is 49.

Martha has 68 apples.
Tim has 30 less apples than Martha, so Tim has 68 - 30 = 38 apples.
Harry has half as many apples as Tim, so Harry has 38 / 2 = 19 apples.
The answer is 19.

Hillary sells 3 crafts for 12 dollars each, for a total of 3 * 12 = 36 dollars.
She receives an extra 7 dollars from a customer, increasing the total to 36 + 7 = 43 dollars.
She then deposits 18 dollars in the bank, leaving her with 43 - 18 = 25 dollars.
The answer is 25.

The volume of the aquarium is found by multiplying its length, width, and height: 4 * 6 * 3 = 72 cubic ft.
Nancy fills it halfway, so there is 1/2 of the aquarium full.
Her cat spills half of that water, so the amount left is 1/2 * 1/2 = 1/4 of the aquarium.
Nancy then triples the amount of water, so the new amount is 3 * 1/4 = 3/4 of the aquarium.
The total amount of water in the aquarium is 72 * 3/4 = 54 cubic ft.
The answer is 54.

Roger needs trail mix for 13 team members, 3 coaches, and 2 helpers, so he needs 13 + 3 + 2 = 18 pouches of trail mix.
Each pack contains 6 pouches, so he needs 18 / 6 = 3 packs of trail mix.
The answer is 3.

The second person lost 7 kilograms less than the first person, so they lost 27 - 7 = 20 kg.
The total weight lost by the first two people is 27 + 20 = 47 kg.
The remaining weight lost by the two people is 103 - 27 - 20 = 56 kg.
Since the two remaining people lost the same amount, each lost 56 / 2 = 28 kg.
The answer is 28.

The cost of Dale's toast is 2 × £1 = £2.
The cost of Andrew's toast is 1 × £1 = £1.
The cost of Dale's eggs is 2 × £3 = £6.
The cost of Andrew's eggs is 2 × £3 = £6.
Their breakfast cost £2 + £1 + £6 + £6 = £15.
The answer is 15.

The garden produced 237 potatoes - 60 = 177 cucumbers.
The garden produced 177 cucumbers * 2 = 354 peppers.
The garden produced 237 potatoes + 177 cucumbers + 354 peppers = 768 vegetables.
The answer is 768.

In 4 months, the boxer will lose 3 * 4 = 12 kilograms.
His weight will be 97 – 12 = 85 kilograms.
The answer is 85.

There are 3 cookie pies, and each pie is cut into 10 slices, so there are 3 * 10 = 30 cookie slices.
There are 24 classmates and 1 teacher, Mr. Keith, and Manny himself, so there are 24 + 1 + 1 = 26 people who ate a piece.
The number of slices left is 30 - 26 = 4.
The answer is 4.

His partner has been teaching for 40 - 10 = 30 years.
So together they have 40 + 30 = 70 years of experience.
The answer is 70.

Mark bought 50 cans of milk, and Jennifer bought 6 additional cans for every 5 cans Mark bought.
The number of times this ratio applies is 50 / 5 = 10.
Jennifer bought 10 * 6 = 60 additional cans.
She initially purchased 40 cans, so she brought home 40 + 60 = 100 cans of milk.
The answer is 100.

In round one, Jeff completed 16 - 1 = 15 skips.
In round two, Jeff completed 16 - 3 = 13 skips.
In round three, Jeff completed 16 + 4 = 20 skips.
In round four, Jeff completed 16 / 2 = 8 skips.
Jeff completed 15 + 13 + 20 + 8 = 56 skips in total.
Jeff skipped an average of 56 / 4 = 14 skips per round.
The answer is 14.

Irene worked 50 hours last week, so the number of overtime hours is 50 - 40 = 10 hours.
She earns $20 for each overtime hour, so she earned 10 * $20 = $200 in overtime.
Her total income is $500 + $200 = $700.
The answer is 700.

Paityn has a total of 20 hats + 24 hats = 44 hats.
The number of red hats that Zola has is 4/5 * 20 hats = 16 hats.
Zola also has 2 * 24 hats = 48 blue hats.
Zola has a total of 48 hats + 16 hats = 64 hats.
When they combine their hats, they have 64 hats + 44 hats = 108 hats.
If they share the hats equally, each gets 108 hats / 2 people = 54 hats/person.
The answer is 54.

The hotel has 10 floors with 10 rooms on each floor, so there are 10 * 10 = 100 rooms in total.
One floor is unavailable, and that floor has 10 rooms, so 100 - 10 = 90 rooms are available.
The answer is 90.

Jolyn is 2 months older than Therese, and Therese is 5 months older than Aivo, so Jolyn is 2 + 5 = 7 months older than Aivo.
Leon is 2 months older than Aivo.
So Jolyn is 7 - 2 = 5 months older than Leon.
The answer is 5.

Peter spent $1.5 on soda because 2 - 0.5 = 1.5.
He bought 6 ounces of soda because 1.5 / 0.25 = 6.
The answer is 6.

The cow initially weighs 400 * 1.5 = 600 pounds.
So it gained 600 - 400 = 200 pounds.
So its value increased by 200 * $3 = $600.
The answer is 600.

Last year: 86 geckos
2 years ago: 86 * 2 = 172
Total number of geckos sold: 86 + 172 = 258
The answer is 258.

The number of books borrowed on Friday is higher by 40 * 40 / 100 = 16 books.
Krystian borrows an average of 5 * 40 = 200 books during the week.
With Friday's increase, he borrows 200 + 16 = 216 books in a week.
The answer is 216.

December has 31 days, January has 31 days, and February has 28 days, for a total of 31 + 31 + 28 = 90 days.
He feeds the birds 1/2 cup in the morning and 1/2 cup in the afternoon, for a total of 1/2 + 1/2 = 1 cup per day.
If he feeds them 1 cup per day for 90 days, then he will need 1 * 90 = 90 cups of birdseed.
The answer is 90.

John's workday length increases by 2 hours when he earns the bonus, so he works 8 + 2 = 10 hours per day.
His total daily pay increases by $20, so he earns 80 + 20 = 100 dollars per day.
To find his hourly rate, divide his total pay by the number of hours worked: 100 / 10 = 10 dollars per hour.
The answer is 10.

Sally saves 1/2 * $6/day = $3/day.
Sally's total savings in a year is $3/day * 365 days/year = $1095/year.
Bob saves 1/2 * $4/day = $2/day.
Bob's total savings in a year is $2/day * 365 days/year = $730/year.
Together, Sally and Bob will have saved $730 + $1095 = $1825.
The answer is 1825.

The beef cost $8 * 1000 = $8000.
He buys 1000 * 2 = 2000 pounds of chicken.
So the chicken cost 2000 * $3 = $6000.
So the total cost is $8000 + $6000 = $14000.
The answer is 14000.

John needs to write 3 * 400 = 1200 pages.
He writes 20 pages per day, so it will take him 1200 / 20 = 60 days.
The answer is 60.

A quarter is worth five nickels because 0.25 / 0.05 = 5.
She gets 100 nickels from the bank because 20 * 5 = 100.
20 of the nickels are iron nickels because 100 * 0.20 = 20.
80 of the nickels are regular because 100 - 20 = 80.
The iron nickels are worth $60 because 20 * 3 = 60.
The regular nickels are worth $4 because 80 * 0.05 = 4.
Her money is now worth $64 because 60 + 4 = 64.
The answer is 64.

It rained 3 + 4 = 7 inches.
So he collected 7 * 15 = 105 gallons.
So he makes 105 * 1.2 = 126 from selling the water.
The answer is 126.

Let the lifespan of a bat be x years.
Then the lifespan of a hamster is x – 6 years.
The lifespan of a frog is 4 times that of a hamster, so it is 4(x – 6) years.
The total lifespan of the three animals is 30 years, so x + (x – 6) + 4(x – 6) = 30.
Simplify the equation: x + x – 6 + 4(x – 6) = 30.
This becomes 6x – 30 = 30.
Add 30 to both sides: 6x = 60.
Divide both sides by 6: x = 10.
The bat has a lifespan of 10 years.

The answer is 70.
